duplicates.certainHint: Identical file bytes or identical decoded pixels.

duplicates.confirmBody1.other: Exactly {count} files are removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
duplicates.confirmBody2: The record that these bytes were once published survives — otherwise the same picture could be posted again unnoticed.

duplicates.confirmNoSidecars: Files sharing its name stay where they are.
duplicates.dismissHint: Stop reporting every pair in this stack as duplicates.
duplicates.dismissed: These files will no longer be reported together as duplicates.

duplicates.never.hint: The search reads every image's fingerprint — it costs a moment, and nothing is changed by it.

duplicates.none.hint: Nothing in the library lies there twice.

duplicates.probableHint: These only look alike. Matching generation details do not prove they are the same image — compare before acting.

editor.downloadHint: Downloads the missing images from CivitAI
editor.generatedOnCivitaiHint: CivitAI identifies this image as generated on its site

editor.noImages: No images yet — click here to pick some.
editor.ratingUnknownHint: CivitAI has not rated this image yet. That can take a few minutes after the upload.
editor.rebuildBody1: The post is deleted on CivitAI and rebuilt here as a draft with the same images and texts.
editor.rebuildBody2: Necessary because the model binding can only be set at creation.
editor.rebuilt: Rebuilt — set the binding and push.
editor.remoteDeleteBody1: Post {id} is removed on CivitAI. Reactions and statistics go with it.
editor.remoteDeleteBody2: The local draft is kept and can be pushed again. Since CivitAI has no unpublish, this is the only way back.

firstStart.adopted.explain: When you bring a post that already exists on CivitAI into Livebound, its images can be fetched to your machine. They land in this folder and join your library — separately from the folders you generate into, so your own work stays untouched.
firstStart.adopted.title: Where downloaded images land
firstStart.adopted.without: You can still adopt posts and match them to files you already have. Only fetching the images themselves needs this folder.
firstStart.archive.explain: Published image files can be moved here when you explicitly start an archive run. Choose a separate folder; nothing is moved during setup.
firstStart.archive.title: Where should published images be archived?
firstStart.connection.explain: Livebound needs your approval before it can read and manage your CivitAI posts. Authorization happens on CivitAI and returns to this screen.
firstStart.connection.permissions: The connection permits reading your profile, models and media, and creating, scheduling or deleting posts and images when you command it.
firstStart.connection.title: Connect CivitAI
firstStart.data.backupHint: Choose a Livebound .db backup to restore it before the application opens. Its OAuth connection is not imported.
firstStart.data.explain: The database, thumbnail cache and backups live together here. The prefilled location is the platform default; edit it now if you want another location.
firstStart.data.pathHint: This choice is remembered outside the database. Moving it later also has to move the database and thumbnail cache.
firstStart.data.title: Choose where Livebound keeps its data
firstStart.files.title: Files on disk
firstStart.files.warning: Livebound may move files into the archive or trash and may delete them. It does so only after your confirmation or at your command, never on its own.
firstStart.finished.explain: Everything Livebound needs is set, and nothing has been read yet. Open the library and start the first scan when you are ready. A folder is read automatically only after you enable Watch for it.
firstStart.finished.title: Ready to begin
firstStart.images.explain: This is where Livebound finds images for your library and posts. Folders are read recursively; setup does not move or delete anything in them.
firstStart.images.title: Add an image folder
firstStart.later: Everything here can be changed later in the settings.
firstStart.loadFailed: First-start setup could not be loaded: {message}
firstStart.models.explain: Point Livebound at the folders holding your checkpoints and LoRAs. Setup only registers them; afterwards, use Hash in Settings to read their hashes and match them against CivitAI.
firstStart.models.title: Your local models
firstStart.models.without: Resources are still read from image metadata and can be assigned by hand. Only the automatic match against your local files needs this.
firstStart.ping.explain: With the ping off, nothing is sent. If it has never been enabled, no UUID exists; after a previous opt-in, the UUID remains stored locally. When it is on, each start sends only that stable installation UUID. Distinct UUIDs show how many installations exist; their counts show how often they start. The receiver is published with the Livebound project.
firstStart.ping.label: Send a minimal usage ping
firstStart.trash.explain: Anything you take out of the library moves here instead of being deleted, and Livebound remembers where each file came from so you can put it back. That covers the duplicates you clear out and, just as often, the pictures you simply want out of the way. This folder is skipped when scanning, so nothing in it comes back into the library.
firstStart.trash.title: A trash you can undo
firstStart.trash.without: The Trash section never appears in the sidebar and the library has no way to remove an image at all. The duplicate finder still shows what it found, but its only remaining option is permanent deletion, with no way back.
firstStart.welcome.explain: A few questions, then your images are in one place. Nothing here moves or changes a single file — Livebound reads the folders you already have and leaves them exactly as they are.
firstStart.welcome.time: Four things are needed; three more you can add whenever you like.
firstStart.welcome.title: Welcome to Livebound
issue.binding_locked: The model binding was changed after creation. CivitAI accepts modelVersionId only at creation - that is what Rebuild is for.
issue.draft_only: The post is only created as a draft on CivitAI, not published.
issue.duplicate_similar: {name} resembles an image that was already posted (distance {distance}).
issue.file_too_large: {name} is {size} MB. CivitAI accepts up to {limit} MB.
issue.large_upload: {name} is {size} MB and therefore goes over the direct upload rather than the MCP route.
issue.no_tags: No tags set - the post is harder to find.
issue.post_image_limit: A post can have at most {limit} images; {count} were selected. Remove {excess} image(s).
issue.publish_now: This post is published immediately. That cannot be undone - CivitAI has no unpublish, only delete.
issue.rate_limit_daily: Daily limit reached: {used} of {limit} posts in the last 24 hours. The push stops here; remaining posts keep their publish times.
issue.too_far: CivitAI schedules at most {months} months ahead.
issue.too_soon: CivitAI requires at least {lead} minutes of lead time; this one is {minutes} minutes ahead. A time that is too close is not rejected but published immediately.
issue.unresolved_resources: {name}: CivitAI may not display or attribute: {resources}. Attach a model version to each resource you want recognised.

llm.hintPlaceholder: e.g. darker tone, mention the rain, no names
llm.materialExplain.auto: A model that sees works from the pictures; one that cannot gets the generation prompts instead.

llm.seedInvalid: The seed must be a whole number between 0 and 2147483647.

metadata.unresolvedCivitai: CivitAI may not display or attribute this resource. Attach its model version if you want it recognised.
metadata.warning.MISSING_MODEL_HASH: The checkpoint has no hash, so CivitAI cannot identify it.

modelInventory.assignment.hint: A manual assignment supplies the automatic identity wherever this file hash is used. Re-resolve checks one automatic entry again and never changes a manual assignment.

modelInventory.duplicates.hint: A hash proves these files have the same bytes. This report never deletes or moves a model file.
modelInventory.duplicates.none: No model file lies here more than once.

modelInventory.emptyHint: Hash a configured model folder to fill this inventory.

picker.noSuggestions: No likely candidates were found. You can still choose any local image below.
picker.suggestionsHint: These files were close, but not exact enough for automatic matching. The labels explain only why they are ranked here.

post.overdue: Publish time has passed — plan it relatively and this cannot happen.
reconcile.explain: The push was interrupted before it was confirmed whether the post came into being on CivitAI. It is therefore not created again — otherwise it would exist twice.
reconcile.notFound: If no matching draft is there, none came into being — then the post can simply be pushed again.

schedule.absoluteHint: Your local time zone. At least {minutes} minutes ahead, at most 3 months.
schedule.draftOnly.explain: Created as a draft on CivitAI and not published there. A draft already counts against your daily limit.
schedule.label: Publishing
schedule.now.confirmBody1: On the next push the post goes online immediately — no lead time, no chance to correct it.
schedule.now.confirmBody2: CivitAI has no unpublish. The only way back is to delete the post; reactions and statistics go with it.
schedule.now.confirmBody3: If it should just appear at a fixed time, “Scheduled” is the right choice. Post details stay editable, but the model binding is fixed after the first push.
schedule.now.explain: Not reversible: CivitAI has no unpublish. The only way back would be deleting the post — reactions and statistics included.
schedule.now.warn: Goes public the moment it is pushed
schedule.pinnedHint: This time is what CivitAI holds. A change above takes effect only once you send it with “Reschedule”.
schedule.raised: Raised to the earliest allowed time ({minutes} min minimum lead).
schedule.relativeHint: Turned into a clock time only at push time — so it cannot expire.
settings.about.files: Livebound moves and deletes files on your disk when you ask it to. It has been tested to the best of our knowledge and no defect in those paths is known — but you carry sole responsibility for your files, and no liability for data loss is accepted. Keep your own backups of your image folders and archive.
settings.about.independence: An independent community project. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by CivitAI.
settings.about.summary: A local-first publishing workspace for CivitAI creators. It turns existing image folders into a place to review generation metadata, prepare posts, schedule publication and keep local and remote state in sync — on your own machine, without rewriting your original files when you edit metadata.
settings.about.summaryTwo: You choose the images, text, metadata, resources, timing and every remote action. Language-model assistance is optional, suggests only, and decides nothing.
settings.about.termsSummary: Livebound prepares and publishes to your own account, directed by you. It is not a bot for spam, fabricated engagement, ranking manipulation, evading limits, or acting on accounts and content you are not authorised to control.
settings.about.termsSummaryTwo: Using Livebound does not change CivitAI's rules: an action CivitAI does not permit is not permitted through Livebound either. You are responsible for what you publish and for the account actions you start.
settings.about.title: About Livebound
settings.adopted.explain: Fetched images from adopted posts are stored here and added to the library. Published images stay here until you explicitly move them into the archive.
settings.adopted.notConfigured: Choose a folder before fetching images from adopted posts. It must be separate from image folders and the archive.
settings.adopted.removeBody: This only forgets the folder here. Files already fetched into it stay where they are.
settings.adopted.title: Fetched images from adopted posts
settings.archive.confirmBody1: {count} file(s) are moved out of the source folders into {path}.
settings.archive.confirmBody2: Moved, not copied — they are no longer in the old place afterwards. Nothing is overwritten: identical names give way to -1.
settings.archive.dupesExplain: Several files point at the same picture. All of them are moved and keep the same image id in the name — in the target folder they end up side by side.
settings.archive.explain: Tidies the source folders: images provably already on CivitAI move to archive/yyyy-mm-dd__post/ with the image id added to the name and the original file extension kept; without a known publication date, the folder is named by the post id alone. Sidecar files come along. Moved, not copied — and only when you start it here.
settings.archive.loadFailed: The archive status could not be loaded. Try again.
settings.archive.loading: Loading the configured archive folder and move plan…
settings.archive.noneMarked: No posts have been marked for archiving yet. Archive them from the board or its multi-select.
settings.archive.notConfigured: No archive folder configured yet. It should lie outside the folders being scanned.
settings.archive.previewFailed: The list could not be loaded. The counters above still apply.
settings.archive.previewTruncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} files. The run moves all of them.
settings.archive.removeBody: The folder remains on disk. Its library records are removed from this application.
settings.archive.removeFiles: No files in the folder are deleted.
settings.archive.title: Move published images into the archive
settings.archive.unresolved: {count} of them without a known image id — those keep their name unchanged.
settings.archiveZip.hint: No compression — images are compressed already, a second pass costs only time. Split backups are put back together with cat archive-*.zip.* > archive.zip.
settings.archiveZip.title: Back up the archive
settings.backup.connectionWarning: The OAuth connection is removed from every backup. A backup is still private account data: do not share it as a diagnostic log. After restoring, connect the account again.
settings.backup.deleteBody: The backup file {name}, created {when}, will be permanently deleted from {folder}. This cannot be undone.
settings.backup.explain: The database is backed up — including post titles and descriptions, prompts, image metadata and edits, local source paths, plans, schedules, duplicate history, settings, run history and recent API-call diagnostics. Image files are not included. A backup is taken daily and before every schema change; older automatic backups are removed.
settings.backup.restoreBody1: The state from {when} replaces the current one — {posts} posts.
settings.backup.restoreBody2: The current state is backed up automatically first, so nothing is lost. Image files are not affected. The OAuth connection is not restored and has to be connected again.
settings.backup.restored: Restored. Previous state: {name}. Connect the CivitAI account again.
settings.backup.title: Backups
settings.behaviour.title: Behaviour
settings.behaviour.watchPostsHint: Every minute, checks drafts on CivitAI and posts on the board. Missing image ratings are checked each minute; existing ratings every {ratingRefresh} minutes because CivitAI can change them. Once a publish time has passed, it checks after {delays} minutes whether publication is visible. Archived posts are no longer checked. Never resolves a divergence and never moves a file.
settings.connection.accountHint: This account comes from the browser session at the OAuth provider; disconnect and connect again to change it.
settings.connection.connectHint: Takes you to CivitAI, where you approve the permissions below. You come straight back here.
settings.connection.failed: The connection could not be completed. Try again.
settings.connection.revokeHint: Disconnecting forgets the tokens here. Revoke the permission itself in your CivitAI account settings.
settings.connection.title: Account connection
settings.dataDir.confirmBody1: Everything is copied there and checked before the old copy is removed. If anything goes wrong the old location stays as it is.
settings.dataDir.confirmBody2: A backup is taken first. Image files are not affected — they live in the source folders.
settings.dataDir.default: This is the default data location.
settings.dataDir.environment: This location is set by LIVEBOUND_DATA_DIR for this session and is not remembered.
settings.dataDir.explain: Database, thumbnail cache and backups. They travel together — the thumbnails are the bulk of it, and leaving them behind would defeat the point of moving.
settings.dataDir.title: Data directory
settings.diagnostics.label: Record diagnostics to reproduce a recurring error and attach them to a report
settings.domain.hint: Applies to links plus REST and tRPC calls. The default is civitai.red, because .com filters to SFW in some regions — a listing from there can omit images that exist. MCP calls always use mcp.civitai.com; a large upload requests its upload URL through the selected domain.
settings.domain.label: CivitAI domain
settings.language.hint: English is the source; other languages are translations. A missing entry falls back to English.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.llm.endpointEmpty: The server is running but has no models yet. Import one with 'ollama create'.
settings.llm.endpointUnreachable: No server answering at this address. Start Ollama, then reload.
settings.llm.ggufPolicy: GGUF models are supported through an Ollama server — that is the route we test. Other GGUF interfaces are not built; using one is at your own risk.
settings.llm.includeImagesHint: When enabled, the model receives downscaled copies alongside the prompts.
settings.llm.lastProfileHint: The last profile cannot be deleted. Create another one first.
settings.llm.name: Name
settings.llm.offloaded: This model did not fit the graphics card. Part of it ran on the CPU, which is why the last run was slow.
settings.llm.processHint: The model runs in its own process under a different Python and is unloaded after every run — the GPU is shared with image generation.
settings.llm.restoreProfilesBody: The built-in profiles Plain, Standard, Narrative and Storyteller are added back where they are missing and set to the text and values shipped with the application. Your own edits to a built-in profile are lost. Profiles you created yourself stay untouched.
settings.llm.title: Local language model
settings.llm.trustRemoteCode: Allow code from the model folder to run
settings.llm.trustRemoteCodeHint: Off by default. Some checkpoints ship their own Python, which transformers imports and runs inside the worker process — with access to your files and your CivitAI token. Turn this on only for a model folder you placed there yourself and trust.
settings.llm.trustRemoteCodeOnBody: Loading a model now also runs any Python that ships with it, at this application's own privilege level. Switch it off again once the model that needed it is gone.
settings.llm.trustRemoteCodeOnTitle: The model folder is allowed to run its own code
settings.llm.visionFixHint: Environments made with uv venv have no pip of their own — a bare “pip install” does not land there. Unload the model once afterwards. Suggestions work without it too, then from the prompts alone.
settings.llm.visionMaxSide: Size of one picture in the grid (px)
settings.llm.visionMaxSideHint: The contact sheet holds every picture of the post at this size, so the sheet grows with the post rather than the pictures shrinking inside it.
settings.llm.visionOffTitle: The model is not looking at the images
settings.metadata.empty: No generation parameter fields have been found yet. Scan a source folder to build the list.
settings.metadata.explain: This list comes from generation parameters found during scans. Turn on a field to remove it from every upload copy.
settings.metadata.modelVersionWarning: CivitAI may classify an upload as generated on its own site when Version is absent, CivitAI resources are present, and Model is absent or uses an AIR identifier.
settings.metadata.patternLocked: Disabled by the saved pattern {pattern}. Remove that pattern below to enable this field.
settings.metadata.promptExclusions.expla: Matches are removed from the prompt, negative prompt and generator prompt variants in every upload copy.
settings.metadata.promptExclusions.title: Prompt exclusions
settings.metadata.savedPatternsHint: Entries from the former text field stay active so none of your existing choices are lost.
settings.metadata.title: Upload metadata
settings.modelRoots.emptyHint: Name the folders that hold checkpoints, LoRAs and embeddings.
settings.modelRoots.identity: {recognized} recognized · {unrecognized} with no CivitAI match · {unqueried} not checked yet
settings.modelRoots.title: Model folders
settings.rateLimit.hint: Set this only if you know your CivitAI daily limit.
settings.rateLimit.label: Override the daily limit
settings.requireTitle: Title required — no post can be pushed without one
settings.scopes.fix: Reconnect and approve all requested permissions. If the problem persists, update Livebound or report the connection problem.
settings.sources.deleteConfirmBody: The following database records for this source folder will be permanently deleted:
settings.sources.deleteConfirmFiles: Files on disk stay untouched. The database changes cannot be undone.
settings.sources.emptyHint: Name the folders your images live in.
settings.sources.title: Image folders
settings.threshold.hint: Bit distance at which two images count as the same picture. Smaller = stricter.
settings.threshold.label: Similarity threshold
settings.trash.explain: One global, recoverable place for anything you take out of the library, whether the duplicate finder sent it there or you did. Files are moved here, never deleted by the application, and the folder is excluded from future scans.
settings.trash.noPatterns: No filename pattern; first seen always follows the earliest library entry.
settings.trash.patternsExplain: Use yyyy, mm, dd, HH, MM and SS once each; seed matches digits. Filename time wins only when every file in a duplicate group matches one of these patterns.
settings.trash.title: Trash
settings.usagePing.hint: With the ping off, nothing is sent. If it has never been enabled, no UUID exists; after a previous opt-in, the UUID remains stored locally. When it is on, each start sends only that stable installation UUID. Distinct UUIDs show how many installations exist; their counts show how often they start. The receiver is published with the Livebound project.
settings.usagePing.label: Send a minimal usage ping
settings.usagePing.why: Livebound is made by one person. Knowing that copies are actually being started is what makes it worth carrying on — and it is the whole reason this switch exists.
settings.watch.label: Watch
settings.watch.modelHint: Check every 15 minutes. Hashes new or changed files, forgets vanished files, and may query CivitAI. No model file is moved or deleted.
settings.watch.sourceHint: Re-scan every 15 minutes. Records new or changed images; vanished entries remain until a manual scan. No source image is moved or deleted.
setup.adopted.consequence: Images from adopted posts cannot be fetched.
setup.adopted.title: Adopted folder
setup.archive.consequence: Published image files cannot be moved into the archive.
setup.archive.title: Archive folder
setup.connection.consequence: Nothing can be sent to CivitAI.
setup.connection.title: CivitAI connection
setup.explain: These settings are still missing. Add the features you intend to use.
setup.models.consequence: Local model files cannot be matched to CivitAI resources.
setup.models.title: Local model folders
setup.source.consequence: The library stays empty until an image folder is added.
setup.source.title: Image folder
setup.title: Finish setup
setup.trash.consequence: The library cannot remove images, and duplicates can only be deleted permanently.
setup.trash.title: Trash folder
spread.previewHint: “Preview” shows the times before anything is set.
spread.relativeHint: Planned relatively: the times are turned into clock times only at push time and therefore cannot expire.
spread.title: Spread publish times
trash.confirm.movable.one: 1 image will be moved to the trash.
trash.confirm.movable.other: {count} images will be moved to the trash.
trash.confirm.noneTitle: Nothing can be moved to the trash
trash.confirm.postBound.one: 1 image cannot be moved because a post already holds it, whether planned or published.
trash.confirm.postBound.other: {count} images cannot be moved because posts already hold them, whether planned or published.
trash.confirm.title: Move selected images to trash
trash.empty.hint: Files moved here stay recoverable until you delete them manually outside the application.
trash.empty.title: The trash is empty
